Kimberly / Marcus — looked at the bank CSV and the AR ledger. It appears the incoming payment hit the Redwood, Inc. (US) customer account because the payment reference matched a US legal-entity invoice mapping in our payments router. Proposed approach:

Option A (preferred):
- Reverse the allocation in US ledger (JP: debit Cash US 125,000 EUR; credit AR US 125,000 EUR)
- Intercompany settlement: create intercompany AP/AR entry to move funds to Redwood EU (JP: debit Intercompany Receivable US 125,000 EUR; credit Intercompany Payable EU 125,000 EUR)
- Apply payment to AR EU against Inv#4718 (JP: debit AR EU 0? — actually we will clear EU AR and debit Cash EU/Intercompany clearing)
- VAT handling: post VAT reclaim/credit of EUR 20,000 against EU VAT payable (use VAT code EU-20) — timing depends on tax period.

Option B (quicker, with suspense):
- Move funds to AR suspense (GL 9999) and then when cleared, post to EU AR and VAT. Minimizes immediate intercompany paperwork but leaves suspense balance until cleared.

I've attached a CSV with the draft journal lines and GL mapping (proposed_journal_entries.csv). We need Marcus to confirm rev recognition exposure (if any) and Laura to approve posting to EU.

Grace O'Connor
AR Lead, Redwood Inference
From: marcus.lin@redwood.com
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com

Thanks Grace — agree with Option A for correctness, Option B if legal/banking will delay. A few notes:

- Rev recognition: this is a pure payment allocation fix, not a contract amendment, so it shouldn't affect revenue recognition balances if we keep the same invoice mapping. I'll sign off as long as cash/AR gross amounts remain unchanged for the invoice.
- FX: bank moved EUR into our USD cash account briefly; we should use the bank posted rate on 2028-06-03 for any FX revaluation and post realized FX to GL 5230.
- Posting request: Laura — can Treasury/GL run the intercompany settlement and post the EU clearing entries? If you want, we can route via suspense for faster customer confirmation and then do the intercompany reclass after sign-off.

Draft GL entries (high level):
1) Reverse US allocation: Debit Cash_US 125,000 / Credit AR_US 125,000
2) Intercompany move: Debit Interco_Receivable_US 125,000 / Credit Interco_Payable_EU 125,000
3) Apply to EU AR: Debit AR_EU 125,000 / Credit Interco_Payable_EU 125,000
4) VAT: Debit VAT_Payable_EU 20,000 / Credit VAT_Input_EU 20,000  (or post as VAT credit memo depending on tax treatment)

Laura — can you post step 2/3 once treasury confirms interco account availability?
